site.description: Late nights in Chicago. Code, projects, and a playlist.

about:
Hey, I'm Ryan.

I write software in Chicago, mostly late at night, usually with a playlist on and an orange tabby named Amber asleep next to the keyboard.

I like building small, sharp tools: privacy things that run over Tor, encrypted backups in Rust, Neovim plugins, and the occasional website that's more fun than it needs to be. This one included.

What's here

  • Projects: things I've built or am building.
  • Blog: notes on whatever I'm working on or thinking about.
  • The scenes: my desk, Armitage on the Brown Line, and the lakefront. Click around, some things talk back.

Say hi

The easiest way to reach me is by email: ryan@ciehanski.com. I'm also on GitHub.
